label: Actual esse effects of the same OwnBeing source are not OwnBeing
paraphrase: Closed conditional consequence for one supplied actual source n with primitive OwnBeing and existing universal esse-causal scope. Under caused-esse reception, received-esse limitation, OwnBeing implies infinity, and infinity implies unlimited esse, the same n is actual, OwnBeing, Infinite and not Limited, while every other actual bearer is Limited, not Infinite and not OwnBeing. Infinite and Limited retain the existing perfection-of-esse meanings, not quantitative size. No source existence, represented identity-to-OwnBeing equation, pure-perfection classification of this mode, real-determination possession, eminent containment, degree comparison, God naming or present productive application is supplied.
